title: Pairing bound below exponent two
statement:
Let $p, q \in \bbr$ satisfy $1 \le p \le 2$ and $1 \le q \le 2$, and set $\rho =
\sqrt{(p-1)(q-1)}$. Then for every $n \in \bbn$ and all Boolean functions $f, g :
\{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$,
\[
\langle f,\, T_\rho g\rangle \;\le\;
\bigl(\E[\,\abs{f}^p\,]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\,\abs{g}^q\,]\bigr)^{1/q},
\]
where $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ is the $L^2$ inner product under the uniform measure
on $\{0,1\}^n$, $\E$ is the corresponding expectation, and $T_\rho$ is the noise
operator with parameter $\rho$. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued Boolean functions f and g
replaced:

$\rho = \sqrt{(p-1)(q-1)}$,
\[
  \inn{f, T_\rho g} \;\le\; \bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\abs{g}^q]\bigr)^{1/q}.
\]
